transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I just can’t shake this feeling that I’ve messed everything up. I’ve fallen behind at work, and the apartment situation feels like it got out of my control. It feels like I’ve ruined things for everyone, and honestly… like I deserve whatever bad thing happens next.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things the way you used to?

Yeah. Most days I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, and the things that used to help me feel normal just… don’t really do anything now. Like putting on a record, cooking, messing around with electronics — I still try sometimes, but it doesn’t reach me the way it used to.
Do you find yourself feeling more guilty or like you’re a bad person, even when you haven’t done anything particularly wrong?

Yes. I keep feeling like I’m the reason everything’s gone wrong. Falling behind at work, the apartment stuff getting out of control… it feels like I ruined things for everyone. Even if I can’t point to one exact thing I did, I still feel like I’m a bad person and that I deserve whatever happens because of it.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like putting on a record, cooking, or messing around with electronics?

Yeah… I have. I still try sometimes, like putting on a record or cooking something, or messing with electronics, but it doesn’t really do much for me anymore. Most days I just wake up with this flat, heavy sadness, and those things don’t reset me like they used to.
Have you noticed any change in your sleep patterns, like feeling rested with less sleep or not needing as much sleep as usual?

Not really like needing less sleep. It’s more that I can’t get good sleep. I’ll lie there for hours listening for noises in the apartment, and when I finally do fall asleep I wake up before dawn already tense and worn out, like I never really shut off.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy level or found yourself feeling more tired than usual, even if you’re not doing much?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I feel worn down a lot, but I haven’t kept track of whether it’s a big drop in energy. Some days I do less than usual, but I don’t know if that’s tiredness exactly.
Do you find that even small tasks, like getting dressed or making a meal, feel exhausting or take a lot more effort than they used to?

I don’t know that I’d say exhausting exactly. I mean, I put things off sometimes, but I haven’t really noticed whether getting dressed or making food takes a lot more effort than it used to. It’s hard for me to separate that out.
Have you noticed that even when you're not doing much, you still feel unusually tired or low on energy?
I’m not sure. I do have times where I feel kind of drained, but I can’t say I’ve really noticed being unusually tired when I’m just sitting around or not doing much. It’s hard to tell.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks in a row?

Yeah… most days I wake up with this heavy, flat sadness. It’s been going on a while. Things that used to help me feel like myself—putting on a record, cooking, messing around with electronics—just don’t really get through to me anymore.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating on tasks, like following a recipe, working on electronics, or even keeping track of conversations?

I’m not really sure. I mean, I lose my place sometimes, but I haven’t noticed a clear problem with concentrating on recipes or conversations or anything like that. It’s not something I’ve been tracking.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately — like eating much less or much more than usual?
I haven’t really noticed a clear change. My eating’s maybe been a little off here and there, but I don’t think I’ve been eating a lot more or a lot less, and I haven’t been tracking my weight.

Have you noticed that you’ve completely lost interest in things you used to enjoy, like putting on a record, cooking, or messing around with electronics — like those things don’t matter to you anymore, even when you make yourself do them?

I don’t know if I’d say completely lost interest. They just don’t really do much for me lately. I can put on a record or start cooking, but it feels kind of flat… like I’m going through the motions more than enjoying it.
Have you found that absolutely nothing you do, including things you used to really enjoy, brings you any sense of pleasure or satisfaction lately?

Yeah… most days I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. The stuff that used to kind of reset me — putting on a record, cooking, messing with electronics — it just doesn’t really reach me anymore. I wouldn’t say I feel satisfied afterward, not like I used to.
Have you noticed that you move or speak more slowly than usual, or that you feel physically drained even when you haven’t done anything tiring?

Yeah, I think so. At work especially, I’ll catch myself just kind of sitting there with my hands over the keyboard, not typing. Even simple support tickets take me longer than they should, like there’s a delay between what I’m thinking and actually doing it.
Have you felt that nothing you do, even things you used to care about, gives you any sense of pleasure or satisfaction at all?

Yeah… like I said, most days I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. The things I used to care about — records, cooking, tinkering with electronics — they just don’t really reach me anymore. I can do them, but I don’t get much pleasure or satisfaction from it.
Have you had this depressed mood for most of the day, more days than not, for at least the past two years?
Not two years, no. It’s been more like… about a year and two months. It started after that pipe burst and I had to move into the smaller apartment, and my routines kind of fell apart from there.
